map_tiles.description: where a map's tiles come from, as data: a PMTiles archive in the host's bucket, which the host serves, or a style another site hosts. A map is drawn from one of these, and changing which one a host serves changes no app

name.description: what a host names it by: protomaps, openfreemap

title.description: what a person calls it, as its maker writes it

archive.description: the key of its PMTiles archive in the host's maps bucket; one with none is drawn from its style

glyphs.description: the key prefix in the host's maps bucket under which its label fonts are kept, as `<prefix>/<fontstack>/<range>.pbf`

style.description: the address of a MapLibre style another site hosts and serves its tiles for; a map drawn from one wears that site's look

attribution.description: what every map drawn from it says it is made of, as HTML its licence asks for

max_zoom.description: the deepest zoom its archive holds; a map looks closer by enlarging those tiles

builds.description: where a fresh build of its archive is downloaded from, with `{date}` for the build's day as YYYYMMDD

geocoder.description: a service that finds where a place is from its name or address, as data: how it is asked, how often it may be, and what a map showing its answer owes it

name.description: what an answer names it by: nominatim

search.description: the address it is asked at, with `{query}` for the words asked and `{lang}` for the language its answer is written in

interval.description: the fewest milliseconds between two calls to it from one host, as its usage policy asks

attribution.description: what is said beside an answer it gave

geocode.description: one answer a geocoder gave, kept so the same words are never asked of it again; its eid is derived from the provider and the words

query.description: the words it was asked, trimmed and lower-cased

lat.description: the place's latitude, in degrees north

lng.description: the place's longitude, in degrees east

address.description: the place as the geocoder names it; none when it found nothing
